from openpyxl import load_workbook
from copy import copy
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime

output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/50630_0_f1e5f5ca/1_50630_output.xlsx"

wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

def parse_sentence(sentence):
    if sentence is None:
        return None, None, None

    s = str(sentence)

    added_idx = s.find("Added")
    due_idx = s.find("Due", added_idx + len("Added"))

    if added_idx == -1 or due_idx == -1:
        return None, None, None

    name = s[:added_idx]
    added_date = s[added_idx + len("Added"):due_idx]
    if added_date.startswith(" "):
        added_date = added_date[1:]

    due_text = s[due_idx + len("Due"):]
    if due_text.startswith(" "):
        due_text = due_text[1:]

    due_text_clean = due_text.replace("\xa0", " ").strip()
    due_date = datetime.strptime(due_text_clean, "%d %b %Y")

    return name, added_date, due_date

# Fill only the exact requested answer cells: C5:E6
for row in range(5, 7):
    name, added_date, due_date = parse_sentence(ws.cell(row=row, column=1).value)

    values = [name, added_date, due_date]
    for col, value in zip(range(3, 6), values):
        cell = ws.cell(row=row, column=col)
        template = ws.cell(row=4, column=col)

        cell.value = value

        # Replicate the example result formatting/types as closely as possible.
        if template.has_style:
            cell._style = copy(template._style)
        if template.number_format:
            cell.number_format = template.number_format
        cell.font = copy(template.font)
        cell.fill = copy(template.fill)
        cell.border = copy(template.border)
        cell.alignment = copy(template.alignment)
        cell.protection = copy(template.protection)

Path(output_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
